queries.title: Forum search queries
queries.description: One or more phrases to search in Google's Forums tab. Each query returns public discussion threads only, not ordinary web results.

countryCode.title: Country (gl)
countryCode.description: Two-letter lowercase country code used for Google result localization, such as us, gb, or de.

languageCode.title: Language (hl)
languageCode.description: Two-letter lowercase Google interface and result language code, such as en, de, or es.

device.title: Device
device.description: Google Forums layout to request. Desktop is the default; mobile can return a different ranking.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Maximum results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum public thread records to save for each query. The Actor fetches only the pages necessary to reach this cap.

dateRange.title: Date range
dateRange.description: Optional Google date filter. This limits Google results by recency; it does not modify the returned date text.

includeAnswerPreviews.title: Include answer previews
includeAnswerPreviews.description: When Google returns answer previews under a forum result, include their public snippet, link, and labels. Defaults to true.

includeDomains.title: Only these forum domains (optional)
includeDomains.description: Optional bare domains to include, such as reddit.com or stackoverflow.com. The Actor adds Google site: filters and keeps the original query in output. Do not include URLs, paths, or wildcards.

excludeDomains.title: Exclude forum domains (optional)
excludeDomains.description: Optional bare domains to exclude. The Actor adds Google -site: filters. A domain cannot be both included and excluded.
